coverage.fixture_identity: Original renderer tests module byte-identical to8d: two tests, original validate helper, five assert_eq sites. All three shader blobs byte-identical. No new tests/cases/helpers/assertions/doctests.
coverage.coverage_limits: No whole incoming210/full-project call graph claim. Repository source lookup found no external read_rgba/HairRenderer::new/render_converged calls, but source lookup is not compilation evidence.

findings.issue: Other output formats are said to remain usable for rendering. The unrestricted TextureFormat input includes formats native tonemap/color attachment creation cannot accept; the readback format match establishes no render capability.
findings.remedy: Say: Other formats accepted by the native render pipeline are not decoded by this operation. Preserve the explicit four RGBA/BGRA supported formats and device-handled validation limits.
findings.acceptance: Do not promise rendering support for arbitrary formats that fail native pipeline/attachment admission.

findings.issue: set_gpu_groom says nothing is copied, but it uploads every CPU atlas mip with queue.write_texture. Only level/card geometry and optional head-cover buffers are reused directly.
findings.remedy: Describe reuse of geometry/cover buffers explicitly and state the card atlas is uploaded from host mip bytes.
findings.acceptance: No blanket zero-copy claim for the entire method.

findings.issue: headless_device promises a full groom fits in one binding from requesting adapter storage limits. Finite adapter limits do not admit arbitrary groom sizes, and upload_level retains only a fitting prefix for oversized input.
findings.remedy: Say the helper requests adapter buffer/storage-binding limits; inputs still must fit those limits. Do not promise full-population admission.
findings.acceptance: Provider limit request is distinguished from resource/count/shape admission.

verified_contracts: New read_rgba is async and returns canonical image::RgbaImage. It rejects missing output/resize-only targets using last/frame evidence before mapping, supports RGBA8/BGRA8 unorm/sRGB, strips row padding and swaps BGRA channels.

Readback host dimensions/row/padded arithmetic and host reservation are checked. Image allocation occurs before mapped view. SDK may separately infallibly allocate a temporary mapping Vec; no universal recoverable-allocation-failure promise is made.

Native readback uses explicit Wait and retains actual Poll/Mapping/callback causes. Browser readback uses canonical ready-first helper and zero-duration browser timer. Creation/copy/finish/submit native errors are device-handled, not claimed observed by the returned Result.

poll_callback checks delivered value/closed receiver before device.poll(Poll), then checks again; no GPU Wait, later health check for ready value, or completion guarantee. await_browser_callback yields only when not ready; zero timer requests task progress without chosen polling interval or actual-zero-delay guarantee.
CallbackProgressError conversions preserve actual PollError/Canceled in BufferReadError, WorkCompletionError and HairGpuError boundaries; browser queue callback rejection limitation remains explicit.

Deformation pending state is per level, initialized on binding and marked pending for all levels after simulation movement. Main, enabled shadow and blend representation levels are considered; duplicate level is recorded once after state becomes Current. Unused levels retain obligations.

RenderedView retains globals excluding head pose/temporal jitter plus main/blend/enabled shadow/min_pixels; changed effective view resets accumulation. Resize resets last/frame/history; frames saturate and mean denominator widens first. Moving policy still deliberately keeps temporal blend.
Original renderer fixture/shader bytes preserved; Cargo adds existing futures-channel optional render dependency without new fixture inputs.

errata.prior: Earlier f0/d449 source reports accepted a WASM detached-view rationale for generic Buffer read allocation order.
errata.current: That rationale is withdrawn for pinned wgpu WebGPU read-only mapped access: get_temporary_mapping copies JS data into Rust Vec before read_slice. Current Buffer comment correctly states fallible host preallocation and cleanup ordering. This does not assert that SDK temporary allocations are fallible or produce typed errors.
